title: Mastering the PMDG 777: Pilot Response Alert Explained & Resolved! ✈️
description:
Welcome to another MSFS 2020 tutorial! In this video, we dive into the Pilot Response Alert in the PMDG 777. 🛫 First, we’ll break down what this alert is and why it appears. Then, I’ll guide you through the steps to resolve it effectively. Finally, I’ll show you a handy method to switch off this functionality if needed. 

0:00 intro
0:20 intro video
0:30 explanation about the functionality
1:32 clearing the pilot response alert
1:57 turning off the pilot response alert functionality
